playbooks.title: JMeter 401 403 After Recording
playbooks.label: HTTP 401 or 403 after recording: login, session or token not correlated
playbooks.rootCause: Missing Cookie Manager: Session cookies from Set-Cookie not stored per thread (web test plan)
playbooks.firstFix: Replay with 1 thread, View Results Tree on; find the first 401/403.

playbooks.title: JMeter Assertion Failed
playbooks.label: Assertion failed: response did not match expected text or JSON
playbooks.rootCause: Dynamic or localized content: Session IDs, timestamps, tokens, or personalized text baked into the assertion
playbooks.firstFix: Read the Assertion failure message in View Results Tree — it states which assertion failed and what was expected vs received. In CLI runs, set jmeter.save.saveservice.assertion_results_failure_message=true so JTL rows carry the message.

playbooks.title: JMeter java.net.BindException: Address already in use
playbooks.label: BindException: address already in use / port exhaustion
playbooks.rootCause: HTTP Keep-Alive disabled: Disabling "Use KeepAlive" forces JMeter to open a fresh TCP socket for every single request
playbooks.firstFix: Ensure "Use KeepAlive" is Checked

playbooks.title: JMeter ClassNotFoundException & NoClassDefFoundError
playbooks.label: ClassNotFoundException or NoClassDefFoundError: missing jar or plugin
playbooks.rootCause: ClassNotFoundException and NoClassDefFoundError occur when JMeter's Java ClassLoader cannot find a required .jar file on its classpath. The fix is placing the missing JAR file into the correct directory (lib/ for drivers/libraries vs lib/ext/ for JMeter plugins) and restarting JMeter.
playbooks.firstFix: Fix Missing Database JDBC Drivers

playbooks.title: JMeter java.net.ConnectException
playbooks.label: ConnectException: connection refused, host unreachable
playbooks.rootCause: Wrong host, port, or protocol: HTTP Request Defaults / sampler still point at lab host or http vs https
playbooks.firstFix: Copy the exact error from the first failed sample (code + message).

playbooks.title: JMeter CSV Data Set Config: File not found & Sharing Mode
playbooks.label: CSV Data Set file not found or sharing mode problem
playbooks.rootCause: CLI FileNotFoundException: Invoked jmeter from a folder other than the test plan folder: Use \${__P(testdata.path)} or FileServer basedir
playbooks.firstFix: Use Robust Relative Path Resolution

playbooks.title: JMeter JSON & Regex Extractor Returns Default Value (NOT_FOUND)
playbooks.label: Extractor found nothing, variable shows default value or literal ${var}
playbooks.rootCause: Scoping set to "Main sample only": JSON / Regex: Target response came from a redirect (HTTP 302 -> 200) located in a sub-sample
playbooks.firstFix: Test Expressions Directly in View Results Tree Tester

playbooks.title: JMeter Works in GUI Fails in CLI
playbooks.label: Works in GUI but fails in CLI / non-GUI mode
playbooks.rootCause: Working directory: Relative CSV, keystore, or payload paths resolve from different cwd
playbooks.firstFix: Run CLI on the same machine as the successful GUI run first:

playbooks.title: JMeter HTML Dashboard Generation Errors & Fixes
playbooks.label: HTML dashboard report generation error
playbooks.rootCause: Output directory not empty: Passing -o ./dashboard when ./dashboard already contains previous run files: Delete the folder before running: rm -rf ./dashboard
playbooks.firstFix: Ensure the Output Directory is Empty Before Generating

playbooks.title: JMeter HTTP 407 Proxy Authentication Required
playbooks.label: HTTP 407 proxy authentication required
playbooks.rootCause: Corporate forward proxy requires authentication: 407 on every request: Office networks route outbound traffic through an authenticating proxy
playbooks.firstFix: Set proxy credentials in HTTP Request Defaults

playbooks.title: JMeter HTTP 400 Bad Request & 415 Unsupported Media Type
playbooks.label: HTTP 400 or 415 bad request, wrong content type or body
playbooks.rootCause: Missing Content-Type header: 415: JMeter HTTP Request does not include Content-Type by default without an HTTP Header Manager
playbooks.firstFix: Add HTTP Header Manager at the Test Plan or Thread Group Level

playbooks.title: JMeter HTTP 429 Too Many Requests & WAF Blocks
playbooks.label: HTTP 429 rate limited by target
playbooks.rootCause: IP-based API rate limiting: 429: Hundreds of virtual users share a single injector IP address, triggering per-IP throttles (e.g. Nginx limit_req, Redis token buckets)
playbooks.firstFix: Set Realistic Browser User-Agent & Headers

playbooks.title: JMeter HTTP 500, 502, 503, 504 Server Errors
playbooks.label: HTTP 502, 503 or 504 from gateway or overloaded server
playbooks.rootCause: HTTP 500: Unhandled exception, null pointer, or DB query error inside the application code.
playbooks.firstFix: Extract the Full Response Body in View Results Tree

playbooks.title: JMeter JDBC Connection Pool & SQL Database Errors
playbooks.label: JDBC connection pool or database sampler error
playbooks.rootCause: Communications link failure / Connection refused: Database network unreachable: Database port (3306, 5432, 1521, 1433) closed, blocked by firewall, or DB not listening on external interface
playbooks.firstFix: Verify Variable Name Bound to Pool

playbooks.title: JMeter Freezing, 100% CPU Usage & CLI Hanging at End
playbooks.label: JMeter GUI freezes, high CPU, hanging
playbooks.rootCause: GUI Freeze: Listeners in GUI: View Results Tree stores full XML/JSON response payloads in RAM, blocking UI threads
playbooks.firstFix: Always Run Load Tests in Non-GUI (CLI) Mode

playbooks.title: JMeter Won't Start or Crashes on Launch
playbooks.label: JMeter will not start or crashes on launch
playbooks.rootCause: Java not installed or not on PATH: 'java' is not recognized: No JDK/JRE installed, or JAVA_HOME/PATH not set
playbooks.firstFix: Launch from a terminal to see the real error

playbooks.title: JMeter Won't Open a Test Plan (JMX Load Errors)
playbooks.label: JMX file will not load, corrupt or incompatible test plan
playbooks.rootCause: Interrupted save: Truncated file, abrupt SAXParseException: A crash or full disk stopped the write mid-file
playbooks.firstFix: Find the exact error location

playbooks.title: JMeter JSR223 Groovy Script Errors & Exceptions
playbooks.label: JSR223 Groovy or BeanShell script error
playbooks.rootCause: MissingPropertyException: You referenced an undeclared variable directly (e.g. println token) instead of accessing it via the JMeter variables object (vars.get("token")).
playbooks.firstFix: Always Use vars.get() and vars.put() (Never Direct Variables)

playbooks.title: JMeter OutOfMemoryError: Metaspace & GC overhead limit exceeded
playbooks.label: Metaspace or GC overhead limit exceeded
playbooks.rootCause: In-script string interpolation (\${var}): Metaspace: Using vars.get("x") vs "Hello ${x}" avoids generating millions of temporary dynamic classes that fill Metaspace
playbooks.firstFix: Fix Groovy Variable Interpolation (The #1 Metaspace Culprit)

playbooks.title: JMeter org.apache.http.NoHttpResponseException
playbooks.label: NoHttpResponseException: target server failed to respond
playbooks.rootCause: Keep-Alive race condition: Server idle timeout (e.g. 5s) is shorter than JMeter's connection reuse interval / think time
playbooks.firstFix: Validate Idle Connections Before Reuse in user.properties

playbooks.title: JMeter Non HTTP response code
playbooks.label: Generic Non HTTP response code from the HTTP client
playbooks.rootCause: Cannot connect: ConnectException, connection refused/timed out
playbooks.firstFix: Read the full message after Non HTTP response code: / message: - treat the Java exception as the real error.

playbooks.title: JMeter OutOfMemoryError Java heap space
playbooks.label: OutOfMemoryError: Java heap space
playbooks.rootCause: Official best practices stress lean injectors:
playbooks.firstFix: Switch to non-GUI for load

playbooks.title: JMeter OutOfMemoryError: unable to create new native thread
playbooks.label: OutOfMemoryError: unable to create native thread
playbooks.rootCause: Linux user process limit (ulimit -u): OS: Default nproc limit (often 1024 or 4096) reached by Java and background OS tasks
playbooks.firstFix: Increase Linux OS User Process & File Descriptor Limits

playbooks.title: JMeter Premature EOF / Unexpected End of File
playbooks.label: Premature EOF or connection aborted mid-response
playbooks.rootCause: Server or LB idle timeout shorter than client reuse window: Unexpected end of file from server: The server closes idle keep-alive sockets (AWS ALB defaults to 60s) and JMeter reuses one that is already dead
playbooks.firstFix: Align client connection lifetime with server timeouts

playbooks.title: JMeter Distributed Testing RMI Connection Refused & Port Errors
playbooks.label: RMI connection refused in distributed / remote testing
playbooks.rootCause: Connection refused to host: 127.0.0.1: Remote worker did not publish its external IP: Set java.rmi.server.hostname=WORKER_IP
playbooks.firstFix: Fix the RMI Hostname on Every Worker Node

playbooks.title: JMeter Socket Closed Connection Reset
playbooks.label: Socket closed or connection reset by peer
playbooks.rootCause: Server or load balancer limits: Max connections, rate limits, or worker exhaustion
playbooks.firstFix: Capture error rate vs active threads on the dashboard and SUT metrics (connections, 5xx, restarts).

playbooks.title: JMeter java.net.SocketTimeoutException
playbooks.label: SocketTimeoutException: read or connect timed out
playbooks.rootCause: Slow server processing: Read timed out: Database locks, CPU saturation, or heavy downstream microservice calls delay response generation beyond client timeout
playbooks.firstFix: Differentiate Connect vs Read Timeout

playbooks.title: JMeter SSLHandshakeException
playbooks.label: SSLHandshakeException: TLS handshake failed
playbooks.rootCause: Untrusted server certificate: Lab/self-signed or private PKI not in the JVM truststore JMeter uses
playbooks.firstFix: Confirm the URL works in a browser and with curl using the same hostname.

playbooks.title: JMeter javax.net.ssl.SSLPeerUnverifiedException
playbooks.label: SSLPeerUnverifiedException: certificate not trusted
playbooks.rootCause: Direct IP addressing over HTTPS: HTTP Sampler points to 10.0.1.5 instead of api.example.com, but the TLS cert only contains the domain name
playbooks.firstFix: Use the Real Domain Name in HTTP Samplers

playbooks.title: JMeter Test Stops Early or Unexpectedly
playbooks.label: Test stops early or unexpectedly
playbooks.rootCause: Scheduler duration set: Thread Group, Specify Thread lifetime: Duration (seconds) ends the test after that many seconds, regardless of loops
playbooks.firstFix: Check the Thread Group scheduler

playbooks.title: JMeter Throughput Stuck Below Target RPS
playbooks.label: Throughput stuck, RPS will not increase
playbooks.rootCause: Not enough threads for target RPS: Little’s Law style sizing: threads ≈ RPS × response time (seconds) when busy (Thread Calculator)
playbooks.firstFix: Measure average response time with a small pilot under CLI.

playbooks.title: JMeter Too Many Open Files (ulimit)
playbooks.label: Too many open files, ulimit
playbooks.rootCause: High concurrency with short-lived connections: SocketException: Too many open files: Each request opens a new socket, and descriptors pile up faster than the OS reclaims them
playbooks.firstFix: Confirm the current limit and usage

playbooks.title: JMeter java.net.UnknownHostException
playbooks.label: UnknownHostException: DNS resolution failed
playbooks.rootCause: Protocol / Path in Server Name field: Entering https://api.example.com or api.example.com/v1 in the "Server Name or IP" field instead of just api.example.com
playbooks.firstFix: Clean the "Server Name or IP" Field

playbooks.title: Site Works in Browser but Fails in JMeter
playbooks.label: Works in browser but fails in JMeter
playbooks.rootCause: Missing request headers: 403 or 400: The server or WAF checks User-Agent, Accept, Origin, or custom headers the browser sends but the script omits
playbooks.firstFix: Compare the failing request with browser DevTools
